from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationDocument(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection, capturing its identity and its outbound references to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[CitationDocument]
